description: This file defines the AggregatedQueueFlowController class, which implements IQueueFlowController by aggregating multiple other IQueueFlowController instances. It provides a method to get the maximum add count based on the minimum of its contained controllers.

classes.name: AggregatedQueueFlowController
classes.description: A class that aggregates multiple IQueueFlowController instances and implements IQueueFlowController to provide a combined maximum add count.

methods.name: AggregatedQueueFlowController
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the controller with a default maximum add count.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Returns the minimum maximum add count among all aggregated IQueueFlowController instances, or the default if none are present.
